name: Inspect Robots
summary: Presents an open-source framework for specifying and running evaluations of embodied agents, with automated setup, execution and termination. The framework is a harness and does not define a fixed task set.
numbers: 6 frontier-model policies; nearly 100,000 downloads in three months

why.dex: Model policies call motion tools on a scripted controller.
why.xr: Rating reflects current uses; the framework itself is threat-agnostic.
